page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred lines; a woodcut ornament below the text. Handwritten inscriptions (Jacobo, Edite à Guffetio, and the purchase note at the lower left) are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: Ubi varia Scripturæ Loca selecta, difficilia ac

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (monogram-like interlace with birds' heads) between the motto and the imprint; handwritten ownership notes in ink (Jacobo; Edite à Guffetio; a purchase note with a date at the lower left) are not transcribed. Show-through and staining at the edges.
